changelog: PERFORMANCE: World-class low-latency media pipeline tuning with 750ms position polling, low-overhead LibVLC audio resampling, and release quiet logging to eliminate lag on Firestick.
WATCHDOG: Real-time EngineWatchdog detects black-screen stalls and decoder freezes with automatic multi-tiered recovery and FormatFallbackChain container rotation.
REPLAY / CATCH-UP: Overhauled 7-day provider archive support by channel with instant search, date grouping, duration pills, and multi-variant endpoint resolution.
CLOSED CAPTIONS: Unified Closed Captions and Subtitles across all 3 engines (LibVLC, MPV, Media3) supporting live CEA-608/708, DVB, Teletext, and VOD softsubs with zero performance overhead.
TOUCH SCREEN SUPPORT: Full mobile phone and tablet touch interactivity for Android Premium — responsive category rails, cards, navigation, and player gestures.
DVR & TIMESHIFT: Hardened background recording service, dynamic Timeshift ring buffer calculations, and fail-safe seek boundary protection.
REMOTES & DEBUG: Extended Firestick remote shortcut mapping (Captions, Guide, Info, Color keys) and live diagnostic overlay.
